text:
Tian: quick flag  CI canary shows SDPA v3 falling back to slowpath on sm90 in a seqlen band around 100-136 when head_dim == 14. Repro and mini-profile below.

Sam: paste the probe output pls

Tian: heres the probe run (local):
```
./rt-probe --model=llama-13b --seq=112 --heads=32 --head_dim=14 --device=sm90 --kernprobe=sdpa_v3
[probe] hw=sm90
[probe] candidates=[sdpa_v3, flash_v3, sdpa_v2]
[decision] picked=sdpa_v3_fallback reason=kvdim_misaligned_hint
[timings] sdpa_v3_fastpath=9.6ms/token
[timings] sdpa_v3_fallback=12.8ms/token
[timings] flash_v3=11.2ms/token
[nvprof] L2_spills=1200, bank_conf=34, achieved_occupancy=0.62
```

AJ: hmm that kvdim_misaligned_hint check was added to avoid misstores on SM90 for odd multiples. Might be too conservative for narrow heads (14).

Maria: do we see this in non-sm90 GPUs? Also, is this only causal (autoregressive) vs non-causal difference?

Tian: non-sm90 (sm86) does not show the fallback. And yes, only causal path (kv compressed layout) trips the check; non-causal full-attn uses different tiling.

PerfBot: @channel perf_alert: sdpa_v3 fallback rate +21% on canary (2026-03-02). PR ref https://git.redwood/sdpa/PR-4420

AJ: immediate mitigation ideas:
- relax the kv-dim parity guard on sm90 for head_dim%2==0 after numeric test
- introduce a hysteresis band on seqlen so picker doesn't flip on small deltas
- add tiny microkernel for narrow head dims (8/14/16) on fallback path

Maria: prefer hysteresis + targeted CI test. Microkernel is more engineering time.

Sam: agree. Also want a perf-counter diff between fastpath and fallback on the same kernel to confirm L2/prefetch behavior. Could be tiling leading to extra bank conflicts for 14.

Tian: Ill attach a repro script and a docker image. Repro steps: 1) docker run --gpus all redwood/rt-probe:sm90-latest 2) python repro_seqsweep.py --start 64 --end 160 --step 8 --heads 32 --head_dim 14 3) collect rt-profiler --dump and nvprof snapshot

DevBot: Issue #4975 created by Tian: "sdpa_v3: sm90 seqlen band fallback for head_dim=14 (causal)" https://git.redwood/issues/4975

Perf-Oncall: looking now. If sweep shows a sharp step at seqlen ~96-120 we should hotfix picker thresholds in next patch. Can we get sweep in ~45m?

AJ: running micro-sweep 64..160 step 4 on a dedicated node now. Will post csv in ~15m.

Sam: FYI I observed similar tiny band for head_dim=10 on sm90 but much smaller magnitude. Might be the tile-size x warp interaction.

Maria: once AJ posts numbers, add a unit probe in kernel-probe-ci that exercises causal path at those seqlens and asserts selected kernel == sdpa_v3_fastpath for head_dim 14 on sm90.

Tian: noted. tagging @Perf-Oncall when results land.

AJ: posted quick CSV to gist: https://gist.github/redwood/sdpa-sm90-bands.csv (contains cols: seq,chosen,t_ms,L2_spill,bank_conf). Summary: fastpath chosen for seq<96, fallback chosen 96..136, fastpath again after 136. Spike in L2_spill correlates with fallback region.

Sam: that correlation suggests prefetch stride or tile remainder causing extra spills. If we can adjust the probe to prefer fastpath when penalty delta < 1.5x and bank_conf < threshold, should avoid flips.

Maria: OK. Plan: 1) add hysteresis to picker (delta_ratio threshold + seqlen_window=16) 2) add CI probe test 3) follow-up: measure numeric parity if we relax kv-dim guard 4) backlog microkernel if still bad.

Perf-Oncall: agreed. If PR is small (picker hysteresis) we can cherry-pick into canary. Keep me posted.

Tian: opening PR with test + repro attached. Will include profiler artifacts.

Maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
